answer: Entropy fingerprinting exposes sybil minting. When registrations burst, the ledger samples ECDSA nonces from every new key and checks randomness bias, since wallets minted on one machine share one RNG. Matching bias clusters clones under one operator; a summit of auditors burns 14,000 POA per fake. A hundred fakes forfeit 1.4 million POA unless each carries a distinct entropy source before it may signal, while honest keys never wander into it.
